今天使用Qwen3-VL-8B做了一下多模态图片的微调，总共有两个脚本分别是训练脚本和推理脚本, 脚本可以直接用，用训练使用的是V100-32GB， 但是实际显存使用了8GB左右，所以我觉得可以租一张24GB左右的显卡可以进行微调训练。微调训练脚本: train_qwen_vl_lora.py推理脚本： infer_qwen_vl_lora.py需要安装的包pip install transformers==4.57.3
pip install unsloth
pip install trl==0.24.0
pip install openpyxl==3.1.51. 微调训练阶段其实就是为了演示下如何使用trl+unsloth+Qwen3-VL-8B做多模态的微调，所以使用了两张图片做下demo展示，训练的过程中autodl的输出如下：使用unsloth进行加载模型，显存的总体占用大概8-9 GB，所以其实16GB显存基本上够用。训练脚本如下：train_qwen_vl_lora.py， 具体里面的参数可以根据自己的需要自行调整，譬如 max_steps=30,         learning_rate=2e-4, optim， num_train_epochs也可以打开。注意一下，如果使用unsloth可能会拉取hugging face里面的一些东西，所以可以使用镜像版本的，也就是下面这段代码一定要加上import os
# ================================
#         ENVIRONMENT CONFIG
# ================================
os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"
os.environ["HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT"] = "600"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_RETRY"] = "20"微调后lora的模型文件可以保存在自己任意指定的位置，完整的训练代码如下#!/usr/bin/env python
# train_qwen_vl_lora.py
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

"""
Qwen3-VL-8B + LoRA 微调脚本
任务：汽车（Vision SFT）
"""

import os
# ================================
#         ENVIRONMENT CONFIG
# ================================
os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"
os.environ["HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT"] = "600"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_RETRY"] = "20"
import json
import torch
import pandas as pd
from PIL import Image

from unsloth import FastVisionModel
from unsloth.trainer import UnslothVisionDataCollator
from trl import SFTTrainer, SFTConfig


# ======================
# 1. 加载模型 & tokenizer
# ======================
print("加载 Qwen3-VL-8B 基座模型...")

model, tokenizer = FastVisionModel.from_pretrained(
    "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen",
    use_gradient_checkpointing="unsloth",
)

# ======================
# 2. 配置 LoRA
# ======================
print("配置 LoRA 适配器...")

model = FastVisionModel.get_peft_model(
    model,
    finetune_vision_layers=True,
    finetune_language_layers=True,
    finetune_attention_modules=True,
    finetune_mlp_modules=True,
    r=16,
    lora_alpha=16,
    lora_dropout=0,
    bias="none",
    random_state=3407,
)

# ======================
# 3. 数据集处理
# ======================
def load_excel_dataset(path):
    df = pd.read_excel(path)
    print(f"数据集大小: {df.shape}")
    return df


def convert_excel_to_sft(df):
    dataset = []
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        image_path = row["image"]
        if not os.path.exists(image_path):
            continue

        image = Image.open(image_path).convert("RGB")
        dataset.append({
            "messages": [
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": [
                        {"type": "text", "text": row["prompt"]},
                        {"type": "image", "image": image},
                    ],
                },
                {
                    "role": "assistant",
                    "content": [{"type": "text", "text": row["response"]}],
                },
            ]
        })
    return dataset


print("加载并转换训练数据...")
df = load_excel_dataset("qwen-vl-3-train.xlsx")
train_dataset = convert_excel_to_sft(df)
print(f"有效训练样本数: {len(train_dataset)}")

# ======================
# 4. 训练
# ======================
FastVisionModel.for_training(model)

trainer = SFTTrainer(
    model=model,
    tokenizer=tokenizer,
    train_dataset=train_dataset,
    data_collator=UnslothVisionDataCollator(model, tokenizer),
    args=SFTConfig(
        per_device_train_batch_size=2,
        gradient_accumulation_steps=4,
        warmup_steps=5,
        # num_train_epochs=1
        max_steps=30,
        learning_rate=2e-4,
        logging_steps=1,
        optim="adamw_8bit",
        weight_decay=0.01,
        lr_scheduler_type="linear",
        seed=3407,
        output_dir="outputs",
        report_to="none",
        remove_unused_columns=False,
        dataset_text_field="",
        dataset_kwargs={"skip_prepare_dataset": True},
    ),
    max_seq_length=2048,
)

print("开始训练...")
trainer.train()

# ======================
# 5. 保存 LoRA
# ======================
print("保存 LoRA 模型...")
model.save_pretrained("/root/autodl-tmp/models/car_insurance_lora_model")
tokenizer.save_pretrained("/root/autodl-tmp/models/car_insurance_lora_model")

print("训练完成 ✅")
训练脚本中有个加载excel成为sft的阶段，可以参考excel的prompt格式，excel里面的格式如下：2. 推理脚本推理脚本就比较简单了，加载微调后的lora模型和原始的qwen3-vl-8B的模型即可，然后输入测试图片可以进行推理。当然这个脚本可以根据自己的需求进行修改。#!/usr/bin/env python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

"""
Qwen2.5-VL-3B + LoRA 推理脚本
"""
import os
# ================================
#         ENVIRONMENT CONFIG
# ================================
os.environ["HF_ENDPOINT"] = "https://hf-mirror.com"
os.environ["HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT"] = "600"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DOWNLOAD_RETRY"] = "20"
import torch
from PIL import Image
from transformers import TextStreamer
from unsloth import FastVisionModel

# ======================
# 1. 加载 base + LoRA
# ======================
print("加载微调后的模型...")

model, tokenizer = FastVisionModel.from_pretrained(
    "/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen",
    adapter_name="/root/autodl-tmp/models/car_insurance_lora_model",  # 关键点
    load_in_4bit=False,
)

FastVisionModel.for_inference(model)

# ======================
# 2. 构建输入
# ======================
image = Image.open("images/image1.jpg").convert("RGB")

instruction = "你是一名汽车保险承保专家。请从车辆里程表图片中提取关键信息。"

messages = [
    {
        "role": "user",
        "content": [
            {"type": "image"},
            {"type": "text", "text": instruction},
        ],
    }
]

input_text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(
    messages, add_generation_prompt=True
)

inputs = tokenizer(
    image,
    input_text,
    add_special_tokens=False,
    return_tensors="pt",
).to("cuda")

# ======================
# 3. 推理
# ======================
streamer = TextStreamer(tokenizer, skip_prompt=True)

print("模型输出：")
_ = model.generate(
    **inputs,
    streamer=streamer,
    max_new_tokens=128,
    temperature=1.5,
    min_p=0.1,
    use_cache=True,
)
